Package com.csse3200.game.components.player

Class PlayerAbility

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.components.player.PlayerAbility
Direct Known Subclasses:
TimedPlayerAbility
public abstract class PlayerAbility extends Object
Something the player can use: it has a name, a cooldown, an unlock state and its own rule for when it may start. PlayerAbilitiesComponent drives every ability through this class alone, so a new ability is a subclass and one registration rather than a change to the component.

An ability is not a status effect. An ability that puts a timed condition on the player extends TimedPlayerAbility, which owns one; an instant or toggled ability extends this directly and never touches the status effects system at all.

      public boolean isCastable()
      Returns whether the player starts this ability directly. Passives return false.

    • triggersOnDamage

      public boolean triggersOnDamage(CombatStatsComponent stats, Entity attacker, int healthLost, int remainingHealth)
      Returns whether incoming damage should start this ability. Passives override this; cast abilities never start themselves.
      Parameters:
      stats - the combat stats of the player taking the damage
      attacker - the entity that dealt the damage, which may be null
      healthLost - health removed by this hit
      remainingHealth - health left after this hit

    • attach

      protected void attach(StatusEffectsControllerComponent effects, Runnable onEnded)
      Hands over the player's status effects controller, along with the callback to run when this ability ends. An ability that puts no timed condition on the player ignores both; it can still reach any other entity's controller through getOwner.

    • start

      public abstract void start()
      Starts the ability. The component has already checked alive, unlock and cooldown.

    • stop

      public abstract void stop()
      Ends the ability early. Doing this to an ability that is not running changes nothing.

    • isRunning

      public abstract boolean isRunning()
      Returns whether the ability is still doing something.

    • getRemainingMs

      public abstract long getRemainingMs()
      Returns how much longer it runs in ms, which is zero for an ability that finishes at once.
